description:
A fat little cassette in a shell that was originally beige and has been handled into something warmer. There's no case. The spine label is a strip of masking tape, and whoever wrote on it wrote fast:

  ┌───────────────────────────────┐
  │ ▚▚▚▚▚  THE METER READER  IX   │
  │ ▚   ▚  ───────────────────────│
  │ ▚▚▚▚▚  VAULT PRINT · 25 MIN   │
  │  ( )    ( )   REEL 5 TAPED    │
  │ ═══════════════════════════   │
  └───────────────────────────────┘

Underneath, in the same pen, pressed harder: "NOT THE ONE I SAID IT WAS. PUT IT BACK BEHIND THE OTHERS."
name: betatape: THE METER READER
